#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const string BAD_CHARS = "VK";
const string TARGET = "VKA";
const int INF = 1000000;

string normalize(const string& s) {
    string sb;
    for (char c : s) {
        if (BAD_CHARS.find(c) != string::npos) {
            sb += c;
        } else {
            sb += 'A';
        }
    }
    return sb;
}

string swapChars(const string& s, int i, int j) {
    if (s[i] == s[j]) return "";
    string arr = s;
    std::swap(arr[i], arr[j]);
    return arr;
}

int slowMethod(const string& s) {
    string s_norm = normalize(s);
    std::unordered_map<std::string, int> visited;
    std::queue<std::string> q;
    q.push(s_norm);
    visited[s_norm] = 0;

    while (!q.empty()) {
        string current = q.front(); q.pop();
        int dist = visited[current];
        if (current.find_first_of(BAD_CHARS) == std::string::npos) {
            return dist;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < (int)current.size() - 1; i++) {
            string swapped = swapChars(current, i, i + 1);
            if (!swapped.empty() && visited.find(swapped) == visited.end()) {
                visited[swapped] = dist + 1;
                q.push(swapped);
            }
        }
    }
    return -1; // Should not reach here
}

int fast(const string& s) {
    string s_norm = normalize(s);
    int length = (int)s_norm.size();
    vector<int> charIndices(length);
    vector<vector<int>> positions(3);
    vector<int> sizes(3, 0);

    vector<vector<vector<int>>> countHere(3);
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        countHere[i] = vector<vector<int>>(length, vector<int>(3, 0));
    }

    vector<vector<int>> prefix(length + 1, vector<int>(3, 0));

    for (int i = 0; i < length; i++) {
        int cIdx = TARGET.find(s_norm[i]);
        charIndices[i] = cIdx;
        for (int c = 0; c < 3; c++) {
            if (i > 0) {
                prefix[i + 1][c] = prefix[i][c];
            }
        }
        prefix[i + 1][cIdx]++;
        positions[cIdx].push_back(i);
        sizes[cIdx]++;
        if (i > 0) {
            for (int c = 0; c < 3; c++) {
                countHere[c][sizes[c] - 1] = prefix[i];
            }
        }
    }

    // Initialize DP array
    int maxSize0 = sizes[0], maxSize1 = sizes[1], maxSize2 = sizes[2];
    std::vector<std::vector<std::vector<std::vector<int>>>> dp(2,
        std::vector<std::vector<std::vector<int>>>(maxSize0 + 1,
            std::vector<std::vector<int>>(maxSize1 + 1,
                std::vector<int>(maxSize2 + 1, INF)
            )
        )
    );

    int answer = INF;
    dp[0][0][0][0] = 0;

    for (int j0 = 0; j0 <= maxSize0; j0++) {
        for (int j1 = 0; j1 <= maxSize1; j1++) {
            for (int j2 = 0; j2 <= maxSize2; j2++) {
                for (int last = 0; last < 2; last++) {
                    int indexSum = j0 + j1 + j2;
                    int currentCost = dp[last][j0][j1][j2];
                    if (currentCost == INF) continue;
                    if (indexSum == length) {
                        answer = std::min(answer, currentCost);
                        continue;
                    }
                    if (j0 < maxSize0) {
                        int cost = std::max(j1 - countHere[0][j0][1], 0)
                                + std::max(j2 - countHere[0][j0][2], 0);
                        dp[1][j0 + 1][j1][j2] = std::min(dp[1][j0 + 1][j1][j2], currentCost + cost);
                    }
                    if (j1 < maxSize1 && last == 0) {
                        int cost = std::max(j0 - countHere[1][j1][0], 0)
                                + std::max(j2 - countHere[1][j1][2], 0);
                        dp[0][j0][j1 + 1][j2] = std::min(dp[0][j0][j1 + 1][j2], currentCost + cost);
                    }
                    if (j2 < maxSize2) {
                        int cost = std::max(j0 - countHere[2][j2][0], 0)
                                + std::max(j1 - countHere[2][j2][1], 0);
                        dp[0][j0][j1][j2 + 1] = std::min(dp[0][j0][j1][j2 + 1], currentCost + cost);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return answer;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int dummy;
    cin >> dummy; // read and ignore first integer
    string s;
    cin >> s;
    cout << fast(s) << "\n";
    return 0;
}
